title: Quantifying the Relationship Between Team Dysfunctions and Performance in Capstone Projects
abstract: arXiv:2608.24634v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper investigates the association between team dysfunctions and performance in the context of an engineering Capstone program. Capstone programs are considered fundamental in assessing the readiness of engineering and computer science students for professional practice, evaluating not only technical knowledge but also essential competencies such as teamwork, communication, design, and organization. Despite the recognized importance of team dynamics in such settings, their relationship with project performance remains insufficiently understood. Using survey data collected from student teams, we quantify team dynamics based on Lencioni's model of the five dysfunctions of a team, with all measures reverse-coded so that higher values indicate more positive team behaviors (i.e., lower dysfunction). translated_title: 量化顶点项目中团队功能障碍与绩效之间的关系
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24634v1 公告类型：新 摘要：本文研究了工程顶点项目中团队功能障碍与绩效之间的关联。顶点项目被视为评估工程和计算机科学学生专业实践准备程度的基础，不仅评估技术知识，还评估团队合作、沟通、设计和组织等基本能力。尽管团队动态在此类环境中的重要性已得到认可，但其与项目绩效的关系仍未被充分理解。通过从学生团队收集的调查数据，我们基于Lencioni的团队五种功能障碍模型量化团队动态，所有测量均反向编码，以便更高值表示更积极的团队行为（即功能障碍程度更低）。结果表明团队动态与绩效之间存在弱至中度的关系。每个功能障碍得分计算为各项之和。
tldr: 本文通过Lencioni模型量化工程顶点项目中的团队动态，发现团队功能障碍与项目绩效之间存在弱至中度关系，强调了团队行为对成果的有限但显著影响。
en_tdlr: This paper quantifies team dynamics in engineering capstone projects using Lencioni's model, revealing a weak-to-moderate relationship between team dysfunctions and performance, highlighting the limited yet significant impact of team behaviors on outcomes.
